info.title: Acme Starter API
info.description: API REST protegida con Laravel Sanctum. Crea un token desde Ajustes → Tokens de API o con los endpoints de código de un solo uso (POST /v1/auth/otp y /v1/auth/otp/verify) y envíalo como `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

post.description:
Always answers 202 with a `challenge_id`, whether the account exists
or not, so the endpoint cannot be used to discover accounts. Send the
challenge id with the code received by email to `/v1/auth/otp/verify`.

challenge_id.description: Identifier of the challenge, required to verify the code.

resend_available_in.description: Seconds before another code can be requested for this email.

post.description:
Requires the `api.tokens.create` permission. Users with two-factor
authentication must also send `two_factor_code` or `recovery_code`.
post.summary: Exchange a one-time code for a token

device_name.description: A name to identify the device or integration using the token.

two_factor_code.description: Six digit code of the authenticator app (only when 2FA is enabled).

token.description: The plain text token. Send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

post.description:
Only available when the deployment enables passwords
(STARTER_AUTH_METHOD=email-otp+password).
post.summary: Create a token with email and password

token.description: The plain text token. Send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

post.summary: Revoke the token used for the request

path.description: Base path for paginator generated URLs.

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

to.description: Number of the last item in the slice.

total.description: Total number of items being paginated.

post.description:
Requires `users.create`; only roles the caller can grant are accepted.
Users log in with one-time codes (passwords are only accepted when the
deployment enables them).

patch.description:
Requires `users.update`. Sending `roles` replaces the roles of the user
(not allowed on your own account; the last owner keeps the owner role).
Requires `users.disable`. Disabling revokes the sessions and tokens.

post.description: Requires `roles.manage`; you can only grant permissions you hold.

patch.description:
Requires `roles.manage`. The owner role cannot be modified and system
roles cannot be renamed.

delete.description: Requires `roles.manage`. System roles cannot be deleted.

post.description:
Pass the returned `conversation_id` in the next request to keep the context.
Requires the `ai.chat` permission and a token with the `ai` ability.
post.summary: Send a message to the assistant

prompt.description: Slug of the system prompt to use. Defaults to the default prompt.

cost.description: Estimated cost in USD (0 when the model has no price configured).

get.summary: Get the AI usage of the authenticated user for the current month

path.description: Base path for paginator generated URLs.

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

to.description: Number of the last item in the slice.

total.description: Total number of items being paginated.

post.description:
Requires `users.invite`; the role must be one you can grant. The link
is emailed and expires after STARTER_INVITATION_TTL_DAYS days.

post.summary: Resend an invitation with a new link
